observations: PRED-3.A1 and PRED-3.G12 are registered 2026-06-17 in deposit 3, the AI Overview Capture Registry, a file versioned in place (now v12.258, dated 2026-10-17). PRED-3.A1 discusses the WARNED capture of 2026-09-06 and the packet #1588, so its registration date seems to be the registry's founding date rather than the date of the statement.
PRED-1537.F1 (group TP11.1) belongs with PRED-209.G6, PRED-620.G1 and PRED-923.F1 (group TP11.2) in the refusal and guardrail mapping series.
PRED-1456.B1 records a result that 'points away from what this program predicted'. It is a possible later state of an earlier inversion-battery prediction outside this batch.

PRED-1086.H2 is titled as the CERN stewardship revocation, but its statement concerns Sappho 31.5. It belongs with the Sappho 31 claims (PRED-1475.H2, PRED-1486.F8) by subject, but it is a different claim from either.
PRED-611.E4 carries a window of November 2026 to January 2027 inside a deposit framed as a speculative history dated 2026-03-29. The date is consistent with its genre. This is a note, not an error.
